moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Monday
moments.blurb: England, Wales, and Northern Ireland observe the Summer Bank Holiday on Monday, August 31st, marking a final long weekend before autumn.

angles.name: Relaxed Vibe
angles.copy: Three-day weekend incoming! Who's making the most of the Summer Bank Holiday Monday? Lie-ins, day trips or garden parties?

angles.name: Traffic/Travel Alert
angles.copy: Bank Holiday getaway traffic building already! If you're heading out this weekend, expect some busy roads and public transport. Plan ahead!

angles.name: Work vs Play
angles.copy: For some, it's a well-deserved day off. For others, it's business as usual. Shout out to everyone working this Bank Holiday Monday!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival wraps up
moments.blurb: The twin Reading and Leeds Festivals conclude today, Sunday August 30th, after a weekend of headline performances from acts like Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Raye.

angles.name: Festival Finale
angles.copy: That's a wrap for Reading & Leeds 2026! What was your highlight from the weekend? And who are you desperate to see next year?

angles.name: Headliner Shoutout
angles.copy: Florence + The Machine, Dave, Charli XCX... the Reading & Leeds headliners brought their A-game. Who delivered your favourite performance?

angles.name: Post-Festival Blues
angles.copy: The tents are coming down, the glitter's fading... who's feeling the post-Reading & Leeds blues this Monday morning?

moments.title: Premier League Matchweek 3
moments.blurb: The Premier League continues with Matchweek 3 from Friday, September 4th, featuring Ipswich Town vs Liverpool, and big clashes like Arsenal vs Chelsea on Sunday, September 6th.

angles.name: Weekend Football Ahead
angles.copy: Premier League is back this weekend! Which fixture are you most looking forward to? Can Arsenal get one over Chelsea on Sunday?

angles.name: Team Predictions
angles.copy: Ipswich vs Liverpool kicks off Matchweek 3 on Friday. Who's taking all three points in the early game?

angles.name: Derby Day
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Chelsea on Sunday – always a fiery encounter! Where are you watching the London derby?

moments.title: Formula 1 Italian Grand Prix
moments.blurb: The Formula 1 season heads to Monza for the Italian Grand Prix, taking place from September 4-6, 2026.

angles.name: Monza Madness
angles.copy: It's Monza week! The Italian Grand Prix is known for its incredible atmosphere and high-speed action. Who's your pick for the win?

angles.name: Ferrari's Home Race
angles.copy: The Tifosi will be out in force for Ferrari's home race. Can the Scuderia deliver a win on home soil?

moments.title: Premier League Transfer Window Closes
moments.blurb: The summer Premier League transfer window is set to close on September 1, 2026, at 11 PM BST, as clubs rush to finalize their squads.

angles.name: Deadline Day Drama
angles.copy: Transfer Deadline Day is looming! Will your team get that crucial last-minute signing? Expect chaos until 11 PM on September 1st!

angles.name: Who Needs What?
angles.copy: Which Premier League club desperately needs to make a move before the transfer window slams shut on Tuesday?

moments.title: Official UK Singles Chart Latest
moments.blurb: The latest Official UK Singles Chart for August 27th sees Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holding strong at number one for a remarkable 23rd week.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: 23 weeks at Number 1 for Sam Fender & Olivia Dean! Is 'Rein Me In' officially one of the biggest songs of all time? #UKCharts

angles.name: New Entries
angles.copy: Dolly Parton with multiple re-entries, and Fontaines D.C. hitting the chart with 'Marianne'! What's your favourite new or returning track on the chart?

angles.name: Chart Talk
angles.copy: What tracks are you listening to that should be climbing the charts? Let us know your current bangers!

moments.title: New TV Drama Premieres: Vigil & Trigger Point
moments.blurb: Sunday, August 30th brings two major new drama series to UK screens: 'Vigil' on BBC One and 'Trigger Point' on ITV1, both starting at 9pm.

angles.name: Sunday Night Drama
angles.copy: Big night for new TV drama! Will you be watching 'Vigil' on BBC One or 'Trigger Point' on ITV1 tonight? Or both?

angles.name: What's Your Pick?
angles.copy: Submarine thriller 'Vigil' or bomb disposal unit 'Trigger Point'? Which new series are you diving into tonight at 9pm?

moments.title: Taskmaster & RuPaul's Drag Race UK Return
moments.blurb: Thursday, September 3rd sees the return of fan favourites 'Taskmaster' and 'RuPaul's Drag Race UK', both airing at 9pm on Channel 4 and BBC Three respectively.

angles.name: Thursday Night Fun
angles.copy: Thursday night just got a whole lot better! Taskmaster AND RuPaul's Drag Race UK are back on September 3rd. What's first on your watch list?

angles.name: Comedy vs Camp
angles.copy: Get ready for more ridiculous tasks and runway fierce-ness! Who are you most excited to see return to your screens?

moments.title: Van Morrison turns 81
moments.blurb: Northern Irish singer-songwriter Van Morrison, known for hits like 'Brown Eyed Girl' and 'Moondance', celebrates his 81st birthday on August 31st. He was born in 1945.

angles.name: Legendary Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the one and only Van Morrison! What's your go-to track from the Belfast Cowboy?

angles.name: Music Icon
angles.copy: From 'Brown Eyed Girl' to 'Into The Mystic', Van Morrison has given us so many classics. Raise a glass to an absolute legend turning 81 today!

moments.title: Gloria Estefan turns 69
moments.blurb: Cuban-American pop icon Gloria Estefan, famous for 'Conga' and 'Rhythm of the Night', celebrates her 69th birthday on September 1st. She was born in 1957.

angles.name: Queen of Latin Pop
angles.copy: Get On Your Feet! It's Gloria Estefan's 69th birthday today! What's your favourite track from the legendary singer?

angles.name: Dance Party
angles.copy: From Miami Sound Machine to solo superstardom, Gloria Estefan always brings the party. Wishing a very happy 69th birthday!

moments.title: Barry Gibb turns 80
moments.blurb: Sir Barry Gibb, the iconic singer, songwriter, and producer best known as a member of the Bee Gees, celebrates his 80th birthday on September 1st. He was born in 1946.

angles.name: Bee Gees Legend
angles.copy: Stayin' Alive and turning 80! Happy Birthday to the incredible Barry Gibb, a true music legend. What's your favourite Bee Gees song?

angles.name: Disco King
angles.copy: From disco anthems to timeless ballads, Barry Gibb's voice is instantly recognisable. Wishing him a very happy 80th birthday!

moments.title: Beyoncé turns 45
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé, the 'Queen Bey' known for her groundbreaking music and performances, celebrates her 45th birthday on September 4th. She was born in 1981.

angles.name: Happy Bey Day
angles.copy: All the single ladies, make some noise! It's Beyoncé's 45th birthday on September 4th! What's your ultimate Queen Bey anthem?

angles.name: Iconic Performer
angles.copy: From Destiny's Child to global icon, Beyoncé continues to redefine music and pop culture. Wishing Queen Bey a fierce 45th birthday!

angles.name: Birthday Playlist
angles.copy: Building the ultimate Beyoncé birthday playlist! Which songs are absolutely essential? Drop your top picks!

moments.title: Mark Ronson turns 51
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning DJ, songwriter, and producer Mark Ronson, known for hits like 'Uptown Funk' and his work with Amy Winehouse, celebrates his 51st birthday on September 4th. He was born in 1975.

angles.name: Producer Genius
angles.copy: Happy 51st Birthday to the incredibly talented Mark Ronson! From 'Valerie' to 'Uptown Funk', his magic touch is undeniable. What's your favourite Ronson production?

angles.name: Funk Master
angles.copy: He's got that uptown funk! Wishing a very happy birthday to the DJ and producer extraordinaire, Mark Ronson!

moments.title: Roger Waters turns 83
moments.blurb: Roger Waters, co-founder and principal songwriter of legendary progressive rock band Pink Floyd, celebrates his 83rd birthday on September 6th. He was born in 1943.

angles.name: Pink Floyd Icon
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to Roger Waters! A visionary behind some of Pink Floyd's most iconic albums. What's your all-time favourite Pink Floyd track?

angles.name: Progressive Rock Legend
angles.copy: From 'The Wall' to 'Dark Side of the Moon', Roger Waters' influence on music is immense. Wishing a very happy birthday to a rock legend!

moments.title: Macy Gray turns 59
moments.blurb: Distinctive voiced singer-songwriter Macy Gray, known for her hit 'I Try', celebrates her 59th birthday on September 6th. She was born in 1967.

angles.name: Unique Voice
angles.copy: I Try and I Try and I Try to find a voice like hers! Happy 59th Birthday to the incredible Macy Gray! What's your favourite song from her?

angles.name: Soulful Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 59th birthday to the soulful and unmistakable Macy Gray!

moments.title: Idris Elba turns 54
moments.blurb: Acclaimed actor, producer, and DJ Idris Elba, known for roles in 'Luther' and 'The Wire', celebrates his 54th birthday on September 6th. He was born in 1972.

angles.name: Man of Many Talents
angles.copy: Actor, DJ, all-round legend! Happy 54th Birthday to the brilliant Idris Elba! What's your favourite of his roles?

angles.name: Birthday Mix
angles.copy: If Idris Elba was spinning a birthday set, what tracks would he play? Wishing him a very happy 54th!

moments.title: P!nk turns 47
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning pop-rock superstar P!nk, known for her powerful vocals and acrobatic performances, celebrates her 47th birthday on September 8th. She was born in 1979.

angles.name: Get The Party Started
angles.copy: Raise your glass! It's P!nk's 47th birthday on September 8th! What's your favourite anthem from the pop-rock queen?

angles.name: Pop-Rock Powerhouse
angles.copy: From 'Family Portrait' to 'So What', P!nk consistently delivers. Wishing a very happy 47th birthday to an incredible artist!

moments.title: Back to School for England & Wales
moments.blurb: Most schools in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland are expected to return for the autumn term between Tuesday, September 1st and Friday, September 4th.

angles.name: School's Out... Back In!
angles.copy: The summer holidays are officially over for many! Good luck to all the students, teachers, and parents heading back to school this week across England, Wales & NI!

angles.name: First Day Nerves
angles.copy: New year, new uniform, new pencil case! Who's feeling excited (or a little nervous!) about going back to school this week?
